evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: alternating ochre and rust diagonals across the centre triangles with the load marker near x 541; by shot-20s the bars merge into one brown filled field, so per-bar sign flips are hard to follow.
evidence.ambition: shot-02s: one flat 2D lattice of 30 mirrored panels with a single load marker and a colour map; shot-08s adds faint wake rings near midspan. No simulation layers, lighting or material beyond the colour logic.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream ground, graphite chords and thin ochre and rust diagonals with small clean legend text; by shot-20s the filled triangles turn muddy brown and lose their edges.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: cream, ochre and rust palette and a mirrored Warren lattice share no shape or colour with the copper beads, navy rings or hex plates in the anchors; the idea itself is a physics diagram.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the lattice is centred and composed, but shot-20s resolves to a uniform filled field, not the settled ochre-ends and rust-centre pattern the brief describes; the end state reads flat.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet; no head-to-head comparison is possible, so tonight is marked as beating the median by default.

critique.change: Keep the diagonals as outlined bars at shot-20s instead of filling the triangles, and set the end state to ochre ends with rust centre bars so the final frame shows the sign flip.
Thicken the diagonals and fade a short trail of the last flip behind the load marker at shot-02s and shot-08s, so each zero-crossing is readable at full size.
Add a thin influence-line curve under the truss, traced by the load marker, so the piece has a second rendering layer that shows where each diagonal's force crosses zero.
